images.title: 가을 햇살이 드는 방, 옷장 앞에 선 모습 (대표사진)
images.prompt: In a room with autumn sunlight, the blog host stands in front of an open wardrobe thinking, hand on chin. Seonggeul, the blog host: a Korean man in his 30s, round friendly face, short neat black hair, cream sweater with a mint scarf. Soft matte clay 3D render, rounded chunky shapes, handmade plasticine texture, gentle soft studio lighting, pastel colors, clean simple background, cozy and warm mood, miniature diorama feel. Use mainly these colors: cream (#F6EFE3) background, apricot (#F2B8A0), mint (#A8D8C8), soft sky blue (#A9C8E8), warm brown (#8A6A55). Korean people and Korean everyday settings. Friendly, calm expressions. No syringes, no needles, no blood, no one in pain, nothing scary. Do not include any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image. Keep the top third of the image as plain empty cream background with nothing in it, so a title can be placed there later. Put all subjects in the lower two thirds.
